records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Re: Search matching — and your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

On your question from the open ticket: search is exact-match only today; partial-word matching is on the roadmap. Sorry for the wait on a clear answer.

Since the kickoff, you've got your first project going in Wrenfield, so the natural next step is bringing your team in — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that with you.

Best,
Nadia
